name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.36.0: features page restructured the way the US vending platforms present theirs, screenshots shown whole inside a framed operator view, and a second live reporting bug fixed. Cantaloupe Seed, Parlevel, VendSoft and VendSys all lead with who the software is for (machine counts up front), a scannable grid of named modules, route and service efficiency as the core promise, money control - VAT, margin, commissions, cash accountability - given its own billing, and a demo or free trial as the call to action. The page now follows that shape: a fit strip in the hero, an eight-module capability grid, then three deep sections on sales, stock and accounts, the phone treated as a first-class surface, and the demo request kept as the single CTA. What is deliberately NOT copied is anything this product does not do - no route optimisation, no dynamic routing, no pre-kit pick lists, no warehouse inventory, and no invented savings percentages. Screenshots are no longer cropped panels: each is the full 1440x900 or 390x844 viewport, the whole screen an operator actually sees, shown inside a CSS browser window with an address bar or a phone bezel. THE REPORTING FIX APPLIES TO THE LIVE DASHBOARD: reports/summary never read its days parameter, so the four tiles at the top of the reports page summed every order ever taken and labelled the result 7D, 30D or 90D depending on which tab was selected; the page never sent the parameter either. Both ends fixed and the tiles now name their window. Cumulative over v6.35.0.
